function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

**Park Ji‑sung** (박지성) – commonly known as **Ji‑sung Park** in Western contexts – is a retired South‑Korean professional footballer who is widely regarded as one of the most successful Korean players abroad.

| Category | Details |
|----------|---------|
| **Full name** | Park Ji‑sung (박지성) |
| **Date of birth** | 25 March 1981 |
| **Place of birth** | Seoul, South Korea |
| **Position** | Midfielder (primarily a box‑to‑box, defensive midfielder) |
| **Height** | 1.78 m (5 ft 10 in) |

### Club Career Highlights
| Years | Club | Appearances | Goals |
|-------|------|-------------|-------|
| 1999–2002 | Ulsan Hyundai (K League) | 71 | 7 |
| 2002–2004 | PSV Eindhoven (Eredivisie) | 73 | 8 |
| 2004–2015 | Manchester United (Premier League) | 292 | 12 |
| 2015–2016 | PSV Eindhoven (return) | 18 | 0 |
| 2016–2017 | Ulsan Hyundai (return) | 20 | 0 |

- **Premier League**: 292 appearances, 12 goals, 1 FA Cup win (2008), 1 League Cup win (2009), 1 Community Shield (2008), 1 UEFA Champions League runner‑up (2008–09).
- **International**: 108 caps for the South Korean national team, scoring 4 goals. Represented Korea at the 2002, 2006, 2010, and 2014 FIFA World Cups, and at the 2004, 2008, and 2012 Olympic Games.

### Notable Achievements
- **First Korean player to win the Premier League** (2007–08) and the UEFA Champions League (2008–09) with Manchester United.
- **Named in the PFA Team of the Year** (2008–09).
- **Korean Footballer of the Year** (2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016).
- **Inducted into the Korean National Sports Hall of Fame** (2018).

### Post‑Retirement
- **Coaching**: Served as a coach for the South Korean national team’s youth squads and as an assistant for the senior team.
- **Media**: Appeared on Korean sports shows and has been involved in various football-related business ventures.

---

### Other Notable Individuals Named “Ji‑Sung Park”

| Person | Field | Notes |
|--------|-------|-------|
| **Ji‑Sung Park (actor)** | Acting | South‑Korean actor known for roles in Korean dramas such as *“The King’s Face”* (2019). |
| **Ji‑Sung Park (artist)** | Visual Arts | Contemporary Korean artist whose work has been exhibited in Seoul and New York. |
| **Ji‑Sung Park (scientist)** | Research | Korean-American biochemist specializing in protein folding, published in *Nature* and *Science*. |

> **Tip:** If you were looking for a different Ji‑Sung Park (e.g., an actor or scientist), let me know which field, and I can provide more specific details.
